formulas.ascii: Bonferroni: min(1, m p). Holm: min(1, max_{l<=k} (m - l + 1) p_(l)). Benjamini-Hochberg: min(1, min_{l>=k} p_(l) m / l). Benjamini-Yekutieli: BH times c(m) = sum_{i=1..m} 1/i. p_(k) is the k-th smallest tested p-value (finite and in [0, 1]); the family size is m = max(tested rows, minimumFamilySize). A row is significant at level alpha exactly when its adjusted p-value is <= alpha; ties get identical adjusted values; untested rows are NaN. Equal to statsmodels multipletests.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
